subject.title: fix(synology-chat): handle HEAD probe and return 200 on webhook ACK

question: Should Synology Chat's plugin webhook route intentionally return unauthenticated 200 responses to HEAD liveness probes before token validation?
rationale: The code direction appears necessary for the reported Synology integration, but accepting tokenless endpoint-liveness disclosure on a plugin-auth webhook route is a maintainer security-boundary choice, not something CI can decide.

options.title: Accept Synology HEAD Liveness After Proof
options.body: Recommended: accept unauthenticated HEAD 200 only for this Synology Chat webhook path after rebase and redacted real Synology proof, while keeping POST token, allowlist, rate-limit, invalid-token, and in-flight protections intact.

options.title: Require Authenticated Liveness
options.body: Ask the contributor to prove Synology can send a tokenized or otherwise authenticated probe before allowing endpoint liveness to be exposed.

options.title: Replace The Dirty Branch
options.body: Open or request a narrow replacement PR that preserves the useful fix and credits this source work if the contributor cannot refresh the branch.

recommendation.title: Accept Synology HEAD Liveness After Proof
